forbidden_actions: remote Git, merge, deploy, release, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent product facts, brand authority, copy claims, customer data, assets, evidence, or approval
perform an adjacent capability or combine independent review with source repair
treat static inspection, stale capture, or model self-report as current rendered evidence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
hard_gates: The design direction cannot pass unless each major visual or spatial choice traces to product purpose, audience, content, brand authority, or an explicitly human-owned taste decision.
Review, evidence acquisition, preflight, and preservation audit never imply source remediation or release authority.
Governance may define where and when artifacts exist but must not invent, approve, or silently rewrite their contents.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
Routing must not smuggle design, review, source mutation, browser capture, or release judgment into the intake artifact.
inputs: Product facts, a brief, design assets, tokens, components, surface context, and references.
A document or artifact purpose, audience, source evidence, and required fields.
A UI request, project state, existing interface, target files, authorization, and design artifacts.
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Translate approved product behavior, audience, brand evidence, surface mode, content needs, and success criteria into an auditable design direction contract.; Define artifact identities, owners, source of truth, lifecycle state, staleness, retention, and invalidation without authoring their content.; Classify UI work, authorization, current lifecycle state, target surfaces, evidence needs, and one next atomic capability without doing downstream design or review.
